title.en: Move funds between two markets of a Morpho Vault V2 (allocator)
title.zh-TW: 在 Morpho Vault V2 的兩個市場之間搬錢（allocator）

summary.en: As allocator, the Safe calls the vault's `multicall`: it withdraws the amount you type from the source market you pick and puts it into the target market you pick. Funds move only between the vault's markets. The only asset of the Safe that may change is the vault's own shares: `allocate` first accrues the vault's interest, which mints fee shares to the fee recipient, so a Safe that is that recipient gets some.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 以 allocator 身分呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`：從你選的來源市場撤出你填的數量，放進你選的目標市場。錢只在 vault 的市場之間移動。Safe 的資產只有 vault 自己的份額可能變：`allocate` 會先結算 vault 的利息，把手續費份額鑄給收費地址，Safe 是收費地址就會收到一些。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: The market receiving the funds must stay within its caps, or the vault reverts. verify confirms that the vault adapter's supply shares go down in the source market and up in the target market.
text.zh-TW: 搬進的市場要在上限內，否則 vault 會 revert；verify 確認 vault 轉接合約在來源市場的 supply shares 減少、在目標市場的增加。

recommendation.en: First check that the target market's caps have room for the amount you type.
recommendation.zh-TW: 先確認目標市場的上限夠放你填的數量。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain (market id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64), and the oracle it answers is 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x64d65c9a2d91c36d56fbc42d69e979335320169b3df63bf92789e2c8883fcc64），回答的 oracle 就是 0xA6D6950c9F177F1De7f7757FB33539e3Ec60182a；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: first withdraw from the source market, then put into the target market. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先從來源市場撤出，再放進目標市場。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: withdraw from the source market.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：從來源市場撤出。

1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.adapter.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into and out of Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.adapter.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它進出 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.en: Tells the adapter which market: the source market's five parameters.
1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.zh-TW: 告訴轉接合約是哪個市場：來源市場的五個參數。

1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.mark.en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.mark.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.mark.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.data.mark.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.assets.en: The amount of assets withdrawn, equal to what you type.
1.multicall.data[0].deallocate.assets.zh-TW: 撤出的資產數量，等於你填的。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: put into the target market.

1.multicall.data[1].allocate.adapter.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into and out of Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[1].allocate.adapter.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它進出 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.en: Tells the adapter which market: the target market's five parameters.
1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.zh-TW: 告訴轉接合約是哪個市場：目標市場的五個參數。

1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.market.en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.market.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.market.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[1].allocate.data.market.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[1].allocate.assets.en: The amount of assets put in, equal to what you type and to the amount withdrawn.
1.multicall.data[1].allocate.assets.zh-TW: 放進的資產數量，等於你填的，跟撤出的一樣多。
